operation.raw_value: Add the Fe3O4 NP stock to anhydrous n-hexane in a 500 mL round-bottom flask and heat with stirring at 900 rpm.
operation.normalized_value: Add the Fe3O4 NP stock to anhydrous n-hexane in a 500 mL round-bottom flask and heat with stirring at 900 rpm.

operation.raw_value: Add BAPTES dropwise, followed by dropwise addition of acetic acid.
operation.normalized_value: Add BAPTES dropwise, followed by dropwise addition of acetic acid.

operation.raw_value: Collect precipitate and wash once with n-hexane, once with n-hexane/acetonitrile (4:1 v/v), and once more with n-hexane by centrifugation at 5500 × g.
operation.normalized_value: Collect precipitate and wash once with n-hexane, once with n-hexane/acetonitrile (4:1 v/v), and once more with n-hexane by centrifugation at 5500 × g.

operation.raw_value: Dry the nanoparticles under vacuum for later use.
operation.normalized_value: Dry the nanoparticles under vacuum for later use.
